hypothesis: The all-action policy fails because UE applies uniform 8 Hz acceleration-mode drives instead of the exact ProtoMotions SMPL force-PD actuator response. Replacing only the post-capture drive mode and per-family Kp/Kd/effort values will improve or restore standing.
single_changed_variable: Post-capture angular drive response: current acceleration-PD versus checkpoint force-PD profile.

locked_configuration.action_adapter: component parent-bind axis plus bind parent-relative neutral

validity_gates: First-policy and first-active-standing input/output/action traces are byte-identical.
Experimental intervention remains off until FirstActiveStandingPolicyInferenceSnapshot is captured.
Runtime readback reports 21/21 controls with the checkpoint family data, force mode, and 500 N*m effort after intervention.
Control reports the existing acceleration mode and data.
Target readback is 1.0 in both arms.
support: Validity gates pass and checkpoint force-PD strictly improves the failure set, time to collapse, and major stability metrics, or passes the locked hold.
falsification: Validity gates pass but checkpoint force-PD is neutral or worsens standing.
next_if_falsified: Retain the known-stable current plant and subdivide the independently harmful axial/arm action families to identify the minimum failing joint subset and inspect its future-reference/retarget contract.
